Corollary
[Euclidean mean value property] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0210 1. ch12:12.44\group Strong Scalar Maximum Principles

If $u_t-\Delta _0u=0$ and $E_r(x_0,t_0)$ lies in its domain, then \[ u(x_0,t_0)=\frac1{4r^n}\iint _{E_r(x_0,t_0)} u(y,t)\frac{|x_0-y|^2}{(t_0-t)^2}\, dy\, dt. \] Moreover \[ E_r=\left\{ (y,t):|y-x_0|^2<2n(t_0-t) \log \frac{r^2}{4\pi (t_0-t)}\right\} . \]
